fast_start_levels.L1: Prepared node: image and shared artifacts already present; no model process state assumed.

fast_start_levels.L3: Host-RAM standby or hot replica with semantic readiness proven; cache remains separately measured.
fast_start_levels.L4: CUDA checkpoint + CRIU process restore only after exact-identity restore and semantic post-restore proof; otherwise unavailable.
